blockers.label: Resend 7-day onboarding with exam merge tags
blockers.note: DEFERRED to Week 2 (2026-05-25). For Week 1, all signups get personal founder emails from Dave instead — templates at cipher-marketing/07-founder-1to1-emails.md (Day 0 / Day 3 / Day 6). Decision rationale: at <25 activated users, founder-touch outperforms any drip on signal-quality + testimonial-yield + brand loyalty. Building Cloud Function infra (functions/package.json + resend SDK + first-time deploy from this repo) was estimated 2-3h with non-trivial risk to existing 50+ deployed functions. Tradeoff was clearly not worth it pre-launch. Brad will surface founder-email recommendations during morning briefings (matched to day-since-signup + activation status).
